_README: Hand-curated trade-counter exclusion rules. Loaded by future trade-counter logic in trade_roast_context.py. Three categories: dispersal_windows (date ranges around owner-takeover events where roster realignment trades happen and don't count as 'real' trades), manual_exclusions (specific trade timestamps to never count), and reverse_pair_window_days (programmatic detection of A→B then B→A reversals of the same asset within N days). v1: hand-curated. v2: programmatic reverse-pair detector to be added.

dispersal_windows.label: 2012 inaugural dispersal draft
dispersal_windows.reason: League founding — initial dispersal draft + heavy roster shuffling. Trades in this window are setup, not real trades.
dispersal_windows.evidence: ups_dispersal_draft_2012_inaugural memory entry; 2012 only-year EOS rollover anomaly

dispersal_windows.label: Balderllis / run-cmc split — 1st year of run-cmc takeover
dispersal_windows.reason: Owner Balderlli was running CMC's franchise jointly; when run-cmc took it over as solo owner, large roster-rebalancing trades happened that shouldn't count as competitive trades.
dispersal_windows.evidence: Per Keith 2026-05-22 — needs date range filled in from his memory or by querying D1 mfl_franchise_history for the owner-change season

manual_exclusions.reason: Reverse-pair partner of ts=NNN; see programmatic detector OR add by hand if obvious roster mistake

_reverse_pair_logic: For each trade T1 (franchises A↔B, asset list X), look for a trade T2 within ±7 days between the same A↔B where T2's asset list is the inverse of T1's (i.e. asset that went A→B in T1 went B→A in T2 in T2). If exact inverse, flag both as reverse_pair and exclude from counters. Subtle: 'asset must be identical.' Two unrelated trades between the same teams in the same week is NOT a reversal — those count.
